description: This file defines a class 'SeoUrl' for the admin design controller in OpenCart, responsible for handling SEO URL management, including listing, filtering, and editing SEO URLs within the admin interface.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Controller class for managing SEO URLs in the admin design section of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles display of the SEO URL management page, including filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list of SEO URLs.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and retrieves the list of SEO URLs based on filtering parameters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding/editing a SEO URL entry.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving (adding/editing) SEO URL data via AJAX request.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected SEO URL entries via AJAX request.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes or rebuilds SEO URL data.
